name: HG Gopalini Priya Darshini Mataji
quote: The atta was very bhurbhura, and I liked it very much.

name: Akshanshu
quote: It tastes just like the atta we used to eat in the villages years ago, exactly like that.

name: Ruchi Mataji
quote: The rotis were very tasty. Everyone at home enjoyed them. The atta felt quite different from regular atta.

name: Nidhi
quote: It felt very fresh and naturally made. Compared with regular atta, the rotis turned out noticeably browner. I did find it required a little more effort while making the rotis. For now, we’ve been mixing the two.

name: Mridul
quote: There is a different taste to it. Everyone at home liked it. The rotis are holding together beautifully, with an authentic taste we remember from earlier, like we used to have with ghee and sugar.

name: Sakshi
quote: The atta is very soft to knead, and the chapatis turn out very well. The dough itself was soft and easy to work with.
